reserve_policy: Five boards plus one fitted-parts spare set; minimum purchase quantity 10 for small fitted passives. Default purchase quantities exclude DNP parts. Full-population quantities are listed separately.
procurement_scope: Default 12+12 capacitor population, with all 32 large-capacitor footprints. Stock values are dated observations, not reserved quantities.

parts.specification: 3.15A, 63V, very-fast fuse, 1206; typical cold R37mOhm; P1=1000/reel packaging
parts.application_check: Input backup fuse. Check inrush and temperature derating. A 3 A supply does not establish clearing of a 3.15 A fuse.

parts.specification: 2.7-23V eFuse, latch-off L variant, adjustable current limit; RPW 10-pin 2x2mm
parts.application_check: R105 sets a nominal 2.69 A current limit. OVLO is approximately 14.4 V. U509 monitors post-eFuse VIN12 without clearing RUN_LATCH. Intrinsic UVLO/OVLO can recover if control power and the latch survive; FLT events still clear the latch. Connect ILM only to local R105; keep parasitic capacitance below 50 pF. Verify inrush and rapid interruption.

parts.specification: 10mOhm +/-1%, 1W at70C, +/-75ppm/C, 2512; two terminals, PCB Kelvin sensing
parts.application_check: I/O current shunt; nominal dissipation is 10 mW at 1 A. Use independent Kelvin traces from the two-terminal pads and calibrate temperature dependence.

parts.specification: 22uF +/-10% 25V X6S 1210; DC-bias/effective capacitance to be qualified
parts.application_check: VIN12 decoupling. Evaluate effective capacitance at operating bias, ripple current, and input-network resonance.

parts.specification: 4.5-28V input, adjustable synchronous buck, 3A IC rating, 400kHz, DDC SOT23-6
parts.application_check: AUX regulator with a nominal 4.96 V output. EN is left floating as permitted by the datasheet. Verify the fitted input/output network on the board.

parts.specification: 2.95-18V input, 20A IC rating, PMBus; 0.25-3V across selected loop scales; RVF40 plus EP
parts.application_check: Core regulator for the 0.30-1.20 V fixture range. The board continuous-current design target is 10 A. Program and read back compensation and protection for the fitted 12+12 or 16+16 capacitor population before enabling.

parts.specification: 1mOhm +/-1%, 1W at70C, +/-275ppm/C, 2512; two terminals, PCB Kelvin sensing
parts.application_check: Core current shunt before the feedback endpoint. Nominal drop and dissipation at 10 A are 10 mV and 0.10 W. Calibrate resistance and temperature dependence.

parts.specification: FIXED1.8V synchronous buck, 3-17V input, 3A IC rating; RGT16 plus EP; NOT TPS62133
parts.application_check: Fixed 1.8 V I/O regulator with a 1 A provisioned load budget. Do not substitute the 5 V TPS62133. U508 generates IO_VALID. EN is supplied from local VIN12 through the Q301/Q302 interface; verify VIN-relative pin limits during startup and rapid power loss.

parts.specification: 2.2uH +/-20%, DCR35mOhm max, Irms5.5A, Isat9A at20% L drop, 5x5x3mm
parts.application_check: 2.2 uH I/O inductor. Verify ripple, peak current, inductance under bias, and temperature rise at the actual operating point.

parts.specification: Original Raspberry Pi Pico RP2040, bare headers; VSYS1.8-5.5V, GPIO3.3V; 40-pin 2.54mm
parts.application_check: Companion firmware: ON and explicit SET scale changes pulse GP10 RUN_SET after configuration checks. GP5 reads RUN_LATCH, GP8 reads HW_FAULT_N, and GP12 reads VIN12_VALID. GP15 drives HW_FAULT_N low or high impedance only. GP4 RESET_ASSERT defaults low; only explicit RESET commands change its request. PG, voltage deviations and host disconnection are warnings. Latched protection requires explicit ON recovery.

parts.specification: Momentary NO SMT switch, 50mA at12VDC, 160gf, -20 to70C; tape/reel suffix /TR
parts.application_check: Momentary STOP and DUT RESET buttons. STOP clears the run latch; DUT RESET leaves the rails enabled. Keep local operating temperature within the 70 C switch rating.

U501 core OVP clears the power latch. U508 IO_VALID and U509 VIN12_VALID are independent telemetry only. Nominal thresholds are 1.319 V, 1.626 V, and 10.333 V. Evaluate tolerance, propagation delay, and temperature dependence.

parts.specification: 0.9-6.5V supervisor, G33 threshold3.07V, open-drain reset, CT open approx20ms; DBV6
parts.application_check: 3.3 V control-supply supervisor. Clears RUN_LATCH on control brownout. The CT-open delay is a supervisor timing parameter.

parts.specification: 1.65-5.5V D flip-flop with asynchronous clear/preset; DCU VSSOP8 0.5mm pitch
parts.application_check: DCU pin 5 Q drives RUN_LATCH; pin 3 Q-bar is unconnected. CLR pin 6 and PRE pin 7 are active low; D and PRE are tied high. An explicit ON command or a commanded operating-range change generates one GP10 RUN_SET rising edge after startup checks. STOP and hardware faults clear the latch asynchronously; fault recovery alone must not issue another set pulse.

parts.specification: 1.65-5.5V dual Schmitt buffer; DBV SOT23-6; T reel packaging
parts.application_check: 3.3 V Schmitt buffering: channel 1 conditions GP10 RUN_SET into RUN_SET_CLEAN; channel 2 conditions open-drain HW_FAULT_N into HW_CLEAR_N. R507 keeps RUN_SET low while GP10 is high impedance.

parts.specification: 1.65-5.5V quad 2-input AND; TSSOP-14 4.4x5mm body, 0.65mm pitch; Ioff; -40..125C
parts.source_freshness: Manufacturer datasheet checked 2026-09-19; distributor inventory not checked
parts.lifecycle: Listed by manufacturer; inventory not checked
parts.application_check: U504 gates only the two supply requests with RUN_LATCH. Pins 1/2/3 qualify CORE_REQ; 4/5/6 qualify IO_REQ. Unused inputs 9/10/12/13 are grounded, outputs 8/11 unconnected, pin 7 ground and 14 3V3_CTRL. Datasheet DS35261 Rev.4-2: at VCC=3V, VOH >=2.3V at -12mA through 85C (>=2.1V through 125C); at -24mA, >=2.2V/2.0V. R307=270 ohm can draw 13.5mA at 3.6V and -1% tolerance; the conservative 24mA level exceeds Q301's 1.8V gate-drive test point. Q301 full-temperature and transient performance still require board verification. At VCC=0, Ioff <=10uA through 85C or <=20uA through 125C with VI/VO up to 3.6V; existing output pull-downs remain required. Same pin numbers do not establish equivalent power-off behavior for another manufacturer.
parts.availability_note: Manufacturer specification verified; no distributor stock, MOQ, price, or China delivery check. Purchase quantity 6 is the five-board-plus-spare requirement, not a verified order quantity.

parts.specification: 80-pin QFN 12x12mm 0.5mm pitch WITH thermal probe; 3M drawing 78-5100-2476-9 rev B; current/SI rating requires qualification
parts.application_check: QFN80 socket for the specified pinout. Verify package fit, actuation clearance, support regions, and probe access against the manufacturer drawing.

parts.specification: Amphenol SMA straight PCB through-hole JACK, 50Ohm, manufacturer maximum18GHz; not -10/-11/-15 variants
parts.application_check: SMA clock input. Evaluate the connector transition, PCB trace, socket, and package as one signal path.

parts.specification: 330uF +/-20%, 6.3V polymer tantalum, ESR12mOhm MAX at100kHz; D case; Tmax105C; Irms4.3/3.0/1.9A at45/85/105C; stripe=positive
parts.application_check: Fit 12 of 16 polymer positions by default. C704/C708/C764/C768 are DNP. Match controller compensation to the fitted population. The stripe marks the positive terminal.
AUX output inductor. Verify ripple, peak current, and temperature rise with the actual controller and accessory load.

parts.specification: 0.56uH +/-20%; DCR2.75mOhm max; Isat44A (30% drop); Irms23A/32A (20C/40C rise); 11.3x10x3.1mm
parts.application_check: 0.56 uH core inductor. At 10 A, DC copper loss calculated from the 2.75 milliohm maximum DCR is 0.275 W. Measure total loss, temperature, and inductance under bias.

parts.specification: 2.7-5.5V supply, 0-36V common-mode, +/-81.92mV shunt ADC, DGS10; INA226 register map
parts.application_check: Core and I/O telemetry. Configuration 0x4297 gives a nominal 2.656 ms averaged update period. Use an oscilloscope for individual kernel transients.

parts.specification: 100uF +/-20% 6.3V X5R 1210; max thickness2.8mm; bias/thermal effective capacitance needs qualification
parts.application_check: Fit 12 of 16 large-MLCC positions by default. C714/C718/C774/C778 are DNP. Determine effective capacitance at the actual voltage and temperature.

parts.specification: 1A 40V Schottky SMA; pad1=cathode VSYS; pad2=anode AUX5V
parts.application_check: AUX5V-to-Pico VSYS diode. Cathode pad 1 connects to VSYS. Check forward drop and temperature at the actual controller load.

DUT reset pull-down transistor; B/E/C are pins 1/2/3. R603 biases its base from VIO so valid VIO defaults to released reset. SW601, U601 or Q602 sinks RESET_BASE to assert reset through R602. Nominal collector load is 0.18 mA; nominal net base current is about 44 uA at VIO=1.8 V and VBE=0.7 V. Verify reset levels and edges on the assembled board.
Input UVLO upper divider resistor. Include its 1% tolerance in threshold evaluation.

Pull-ups, divider resistors, and logic bias. R306 biases IO_EN_INHIBIT from VIN12. R507 holds RUN_SET low while Pico GP10 is high impedance. Check dissipation at maximum input voltage. R516 pulls the independent VIN12_VALID monitor output high; it is not on the fault bus.
Input OVLO upper divider resistor. Evaluate the resulting threshold with device and resistor tolerances.
R105 sets eFuse current limit. R503 forms the core OVP divider with R504. Route OVP sense independently from the socket supply plane.
R107 sets AUX output voltage. R514 forms the post-eFuse input detector divider with R515; nominal threshold 10.333 V.
Core AVIN damping and core/I/O INA226 differential input filters. Place monitor filter components close to their ICs.

parts.specification: 12.1kOhm +/-1%, 0.1W at70C, +/-100ppm/C, 0603; automotive AC series, same strap value
parts.application_check: R204/MSEL1 and R208/VSEL strap resistors. Preserve the specified resistance, tolerance, and package.
R205 sets the MSEL1 startup strap. R603 biases Q601 from VIO for default reset release and limits the explicit reset sink current. Verify DUT reset high/low levels and remote-reset timing.
MSEL2 upper strap resistor for the configured startup behavior. Preserve its 1% tolerance.
R209 connects ADRSEL to ground with no upper resistor. The 4.64 kohm value selects 7-bit PMBus address 0x10 and automatic SYNC detection.
Control pull-downs and NTC divider. Use the specified resistance and tolerance. R411 holds RESET_ASSERT low when Pico GP4 is high impedance; place it beside Q602.
3.3 V I2C pull-ups. Nominal low-state current is 1.5 mA per line. Measure rise time with the installed bus capacitance.
R601 clock termination; DNP by default. Confirm source configuration, receiver amplitude, and driver loading before fitting.
R511 forms the I/O-valid divider with R512; nominal threshold 1.626 V.
R504 is the core OVP lower resistor; R512 is the I/O-valid lower resistor. Include reference, offset, and resistor tolerances in threshold evaluation.
Switch-node snubber resistor. Determine pulse dissipation, temperature, and damping from measured ringing.

parts.specification: 47Ohm +/-1%, 0.5W, +/-100ppm/C, 0805; core bleed30.6mW at1.2V; thermal derating applies
parts.datasheet_note: Verified exact distributor item; manufacturer datasheet link available in Documents section. Guessed manufacturer URL deliberately not used.
parts.application_check: R212 core discharge resistor. Nominal dissipation is 30.6 mW at 1.2 V. Confirm measured discharge below 50 mV before changing feedback scale.

parts.specification: 100Ohm +/-1%, 0.5W, +/-100ppm/C, 0805; IO bleed32.4mW at1.8V; thermal derating applies
parts.datasheet_note: Verified exact distributor item; manufacturer datasheet link available in Documents section. Guessed manufacturer URL deliberately not used.
parts.application_check: R304 discharges I/O. R308 limits Q302 gate discharge and coupling into IO_EN. Preserve the 100 ohm, 0.5 W, 0805 specification and verify pulse stress.
Board-temperature NTC with a 100 kohm divider resistor. Calibrate the conversion. This sensor does not measure die junction temperature.
VIN/AVIN bypass. Evaluate effective capacitance at operating bias and place AVIN filtering close to the regulator.
Input and regulator bypass and monitor supply bypass. Follow local return and placement requirements.
eFuse slew control, I/O soft start, and INA226 differential filtering. Verify startup timing and monitor response.
C106/C301 VIN12 input bypass: 10 uF, 35 V, X7R, 1206. Check effective capacitance and input-loop placement.
AUX5V, I/O, and Pico VSYS bypass. Evaluate effective capacitance and the X5R temperature range at the actual operating conditions.
U201 VDD5 bypass. Place close to the IC with a short PGND return.
BP1V5 bypass. Connect the negative terminal only to DRTN, not board ground.
Local PVIN ceramic bypass. Place close to the regulator power pins with a short return loop.
C210 forms the switch-node snubber with R203. C306 provides VIN12-to-IO_EN_INHIBIT feedforward. C306 is mandatory at 1 nF C0G, +/-5%; verify startup and input-loss transients.
Local 100 nF bypass, including one capacitor for consolidated U504 and U509. Keep supply and return connections short.
Sixteen local core 1 uF capacitors. Evaluate effective capacitance and package temperature in the assembled board.
I/O bulk decoupling. Confirm the exact ordering code and effective capacitance with the current supplier specification.
Local I/O decoupling. Include bias and temperature dependence in the I/O stability evaluation.

parts.specification: 1x2 2.54mm vertical THT male header; tail3mm; square0.64mm
parts.application_check: J601 is for a high-impedance differential probe, not load delivery or a 50 ohm input. J602 remote reset: pin 1 Zed Pmod 3.3 V, pin 2 GPIO low/high-impedance. Pin 2 is not ground.

parts.specification: 1x5 2.54mm vertical THT male header; tail3mm; square0.64mm
parts.application_check: 3.3 V PMBus debug connector. External equipment must not drive an unpowered control domain.

parts.specification: 1x6 2.54mm vertical THT male header; tail3mm; square0.64mm
parts.application_check: Six-pin JTAG connector with 1.8 V VTref. Match external signal levels to the I/O rail.

parts.specification: 2x10 2.54mm vertical THT male header; JTAG signal interface with 1.8 V VTref
parts.application_check: 2x10 JTAG connector. Verify pin-1 orientation and cable pinout. It is a signal interface, not a core-power connector.

parts.specification: AMASS24.243 series4mm angled single-pole banana socket; RED; 30Vac/60Vdc, max24A, contact resistance<=5mOhm; silver-plated brass, PA insulation; two electrically common solder legs, pitch15.7mm per manufacturer VER2.0.
parts.lifecycle: Listed for sale / manufacturer lifecycle unverified
parts.application_check: J101 positive input connector; both pins connect to VIN_RAW. Local footprint pitch is 15.7 mm. Verify the 2.5 mm drill, 3.5 mm pads, and body dimensions against the physical part. Use a full-current supply lead.

parts.specification: AMASS24.243 series4mm angled single-pole banana socket; BLACK; 30Vac/60Vdc, max24A, contact resistance<=5mOhm; silver-plated brass, PA insulation; two electrically common solder legs, pitch15.7mm per manufacturer VER2.0.
parts.lifecycle: Listed for sale / manufacturer lifecycle unverified
parts.application_check: J102 negative input connector; both pins connect to GND. Local footprint pitch is 15.7 mm. Verify the 2.5 mm drill, 3.5 mm pads, and body dimensions against the physical part. Use a full-current return lead.

parts.specification: GB rank phototransistor optocoupler, SO4 4.55x2.6mm pitch1.27mm; 1=A,2=K,3=E,4=C; VCEsat max0.3V at IF1mA/IC0.2mA,25C
parts.application_check: Remote-reset optocoupler; preserve the GB selection. Input power comes from Zed 3.3 V with a low/high-impedance GPIO return. Collector connects to RESET_BASE and emitter to board ground. Verify levels and timing over the intended temperature range.

parts.specification: 750Ohm +/-1% 0.1W at70C, 0603 thick film, +/-100ppm/C; 13=330mm reel, cut tape MOQ1
parts.application_check: R605 optocoupler LED resistor. Include the applicable ZedBoard Pmod series resistance when checking LED current and GPIO low-state drive.

parts.specification: 60V NMOS, +/-20V VGS, SOT23 G1/S2/D3; RDS(on)<=4Ohm atVGS1.8V/25C; -55..150C operating range; full-temperature electrical maxima not generally specified
parts.application_check: Q301/Q302 I/O-enable interface, G/S/D on pins 1/2/3. Q301 pulls IO_EN_INHIBIT down through R308; Q302 pulls EN down. Fit C306 and C307. Verify local VIN-relative EN limits during startup, enable transitions, and input loss with USB power maintained. Q602 independently sinks RESET_BASE on an explicit high RESET_ASSERT request from Pico GP4. R411 holds its gate low by default; place R411 beside Q602. This request does not gate power.

parts.application_check: R305 connects VIN12 to IO_EN and forms a divider with R303. Use the specified 0.25 W, 1206 part. At 14.4 V with EN low, dissipation is approximately 95 mW including -1% resistance tolerance.

R303 is the EN divider lower resistor. R307 pulls IO_EN_CTRL low. At 3.6 V and -1% tolerance, R307 draws approximately 13.5 mA and dissipates 49 mW. Verify logic drive and local temperature; the interface thermal review target is at most 85 C at R307.

parts.lifecycle: Not for new designs / distributor stock listed
parts.application_check: C307 is mandatory at 100 pF C0G, +/-5%, from IO_EN to ground. Verify startup and command transients with actual parasitics and probe loading. The catalog records this exact part as NRND; qualify any substitution.
